rule: Training only if data admission passes AND one-question optimistic total and marginal world-prefix net timing-bootstrap95% LOWER bounds both >0 ms. Nine repetition blocks, original questions grouped within each repetition; independently resampled Composer cost. No scene/population CI claimed.
overhead: Measured Native generation vs cache-owning executor, planner, untrained K64 structural forward cost, independent candidate/anchor replay. No common Native generation cost charged twice.
limitation: Screening evidence for potential gain with measurement uncertainty, not proof of service performance or universal impossibility.
data_identity_checks: At least12 independently scored correct TRAIN extensions, zero observed wrong in train/dev validation, unknown<=5% each; sparse sampling gaps are not continuous transitions.
